feed_summary: Deceptive prompts lure AI agents into decoys and dead ends, cutting attack success by up to 91% in tests and raising the cost of a successful attack 23-fold. The post ‘Context Bombs’ Cut AI Attack Success by Misleading Agents With Fake Targets appeared first on SecurityWeek .
title: ‘Context Bombs’ Cut AI Attack Success by Misleading Agents With Fake Targets
